what: the day's ranked clusters, in the desk's own one line, sources counted and linked (Jack, 5 October 2026)
what_a_wire_line_is: Each line is the desk's own one-line summary of a story it ranked, with its sources counted and linked. It is not a story the desk wrote or checked; only the item with a badge was checked.

items.line: CoinDCX lost $16M from retired wallets after CEO Sumit Gupta had denied breach reports as a false alarm.
titles: CoinDCX confirms $16 million loss from retired wallets days after CEO called breach reports a ‘false alarm’
CoinDCX confirms $16M loss from retired wallets after breach reports

items.line: UK banks received 10,000 complaints in three months over crypto purchase restrictions, conflicting with the nation's crypto hub aspirations.
titles: UK banks face 10,000 complaints in 3 months over crypto restrictions

items.line: ECB official Piero Cipollone said the EU plans to test digital euro transactions in 2027 and launch as early as 2029 pending legislation.
titles: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’

items.line: Crypto longs lost $404M in four hours as bitcoin dipped below $80K; spot ETFs saw $773M in outflows after three days of inflows.
titles: Crypto longs lose $404 million in four hours as bitcoin briefly slips below $80,000

items.line: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Intuit and three others joined 16 prior companies objecting to trading their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue.
titles: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Intuit Among 6 More Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks

items.line: Keystone hardware wallet breach exposed customer data the company claimed it deletes after 180 days; X users challenged the deletion promise.
titles: Keystone customers say breach exposed data the hardware wallet maker promised to delete

checked.says: Crypto Briefing reports CoinDCX confirmed roughly $16 million loss (15.99 million USDT plus 5,784 TRX) from retired wallets after its automated sweeping service failed, with the exchange absorbing the hit itself.
checked.unconfirmed: The timing and exact wording of the CEO's prior 'false alarm' characterization could not be verified from the readable source; only the October 21 loss confirmation was confirmed.
